title: He was no good at sums
html_source: Joyce is systematically exaggerating his own vulnerability at Clongowes: but math was his weakest subject [table].

anchor.text: He was no good at sums
anchor.prefix: Stephen tried his best but the sum was too hard and he felt confused. The little silk badge with the white rose on it that was pinned on the breast of his jacket began to flutter.
